projects.title: My Portfolio
projects.bodyText:
- My Portfolio website is made in React
 -  Fully customisable and dynamic, easily change data and images.
 - Dark Mode Support

projects.title: Women Safety App
projects.bodyText:
- A mobile application that helps women in distress by sending **SMS messages** to pre-saved emergency contacts with their live location.
 - Built using **Java** for Android platform

projects.title: UJ Online Attendance System using Face Recognition
projects.bodyText:
- A Python application that uses **face recognition** to mark attendance of students in a class.
 - Built using **Tkinter**, pretrained **Haarcascade_frontalface_default** and **LBPH** algorithm.
 - Uses **MySQL** database and **CSV** file to store student data and attendance records.

projects.title: Malware Detection using API Calls
projects.bodyText:
- A Jupyter Notebook project that analyses **API call** sequences to **detect malware** using **Machine Learning** and **Deep Learning** techniques.
 - Utilizes datasets containing **API call** sequences from both **benign** and **malicious** software to train and evaluate models.
 - Implements algorithms such as **Decision Trees**, **Random Forests**, and **Support Vector Machines** for classification tasks against **CNN LSTM**.

projects.title: Pizza Order App
projects.bodyText:
- A JavaScript-based web application that uses a **mock API** to fetch pizza data. 
 - Allows users to add pizzas to a cart, view the cart, place orders, and view order history.
 - Built with **HTML**, **CSS**, **JavaScript**.

projects.title: Maths and Science Chatbot
projects.bodyText:
- A chatbot built using **Python** and **Gemini API** that helps students with their Maths and Science questions.
 - Utilizes **Natural Language Processing (NLP)** techniques to understand and respond to user queries.
 - Provides explanations, examples, and step-by-step solutions to various topics in Maths and Science.

projects.title: S3 Storage Example
projects.bodyText:
- An Python web application that demonstrates how to upload and retrieve files from **AWS S3** using **Boto3** library.
 - Built with **Django** framework for the backend and **Tailwind** framework for the frontend.
 - Allows users to upload files to an S3 bucket and view/download them.

projects.title: Mocha Bootcamp Tests
projects.bodyText:
- A collection of test cases written in **JavaScript** using the **Mocha** testing framework.
 - Covers various scenarios and edge cases for different functions and modules.
 - Helps in ensuring code quality and reliability through automated testing.
